title: Implement botspy show
description: botspy show <session-id>: open one session (SessionStore::open) and render header + messages. --message N selects one message. -o json is the full Session; -o ndjson streams one Message per line. Unknown id is exit 1. Spec: features/cli/show.feature.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Done: show verb passes all 9 scenarios in features/cli/30_show.feature — id/prefix resolution against the unified listing (exact wins, ambiguous lists candidates, unknown exits 1), human rendering (header, #N role ts message lines, indented part lines), --message N selection with out-of-range exit 1, json = full Session, ndjson = one Message per line. Prefix-success scenario asserts the resolved full id via --no-truncate.
